topic.title: Inland Waterways / Canals / Waterside Development
topic.source_contract: navigation authority, notified area, waterway and towpath boundary, navigation rights, structural interface, drainage, ecology, flood risk, access, consents, construction and operational waterway evidence

scope_guards: Proximity to a canal is not treated as Canal & River Trust land ownership.
A notified-area flag is not treated as planning objection or approval.
A planning consultation is not treated as waterway consent.
A mooring indication is not treated as an operational mooring right.
A drainage proposal is not treated as an approved discharge.
A towpath link is not treated as secured public access.
Construction beside a waterway is not treated as completed structural acceptance.
No score or promotion is written without exact ownership, navigation, consents, engineering, construction and operational evidence.
